description: This file defines a React component 'SearchBar' that provides a stylized search input with optional clear button and shortcut hint. It handles user interactions like focus, blur, clearing input, and forwarding refs.

methods.name: setRefs
methods.description: Sets the ref for the input element and forwards it if necessary.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles input value change events, calling the supplied onChange prop.

methods.name: handleClear
methods.description: Clears the input value and refocuses the input.

methods.name: handleFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updating internal state and calling optional onFocus callback.

methods.name: handleBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event, updating internal state and calling optional onBlur callback.
